GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (29 Oct 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 208)
APO 500
29 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Chinese.
1. Reference is made to the following:
a. Letter your office, C.L.O. 369, 23 October 1945, requesting permission to repatriate Chinese Laborers on the Enoshima Maru and further, if request is approved, that US guards be placed aboard to maintain discipline.
b. Letter SCAJAP Serial P-524, 26 October 1945, subject, "Japanese Merchant Ship Enoshima Maru, Sailing of"" authorizes 1500 repatriated on return, only Chinese from North China to be loaded.
2. Sixth Army has been directed to place guards aboard in other to maintain discipline.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
